recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key studio composition featuring seven distinct poses of the same male subject arranged in a horizontal line across the bottom third of a stark white square frame, topped with extremely wide-tracked serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Extreme vertical division between the empty top two-thirds and the populated bottom third
Rhythmic repetition of the subject in various casual and confident stances
Tonal unity between the subject's white clothing and the seamless white background
Delicate balance between the thin, airy typography and the grounded row of figures
coreInvariants: High-key lighting with soft shadows at the feet
Vast expanse of negative space in the upper center

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are scaled small and anchored to the bottom edge, occupying roughly 35% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The horizontal row of figures acts as a heavy base for the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top typography, drops through the white void, and scans left-to-right across the character poses.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant white negative space creates a sense of lightness and focus.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm skin tones and dark hair (Secondary)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Olive-gold or muted bronze for the typography
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extremely high value (brightness) with low saturation, relying on subtle shadow gradients for form.

composition.relationshipToImage: Floating in the upper negative space

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used with extreme tracking to create a graphic bar effect.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic proportions and elegant serifs matching the era.
Traditional Roman structure with high legibility at wide spacing.
Standard serif skeleton that achieves this look when tracked out.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key studio photograph of a man in white 70s leisure clothing, repeated in 7 different poses (standing, leaning, sitting) arranged in a horizontal line at the bottom of a square white frame. Ensure soft shadows on the floor and a vast white void above.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place the name in a light-weight serif font at the very top, centered, using all-caps and extreme letter-spacing so the text spans nearly the full width of the frame.

verificationChecks: Is the top two-thirds of the image primarily empty white space?
Are the figures aligned horizontally at the bottom?
Is the typography tracked out to at least 5x its normal width?

adjustableVariables: Vertical position of the figure row
mustRedesign: Do not use the specific artist's name
Do not replicate the specific face of the subject
Ensure the graphic on the subject's shirt is generic or removed
postGenerationChecks: Check for seamless blending of the white clothing into the background.
Verify the tracking of the text is wide enough to feel like a decorative element.
Ensure the figures do not overlap in a way that creates visual clutter.
Confirm the square aspect ratio is maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key studio photography + horizontal multi-pose repetition + bottom-weighted composition + top-aligned wide-tracked serif typography.
